settings.title: Settings
settings.comfort: Shorter exhale, just go at your pace

safety.cold: Cold on the face can slow your heart rate. Skip it if you have a heart condition, take medication that affects heart rate, tend to faint, or have a skin condition on your face. Use cool water or a wrapped ice pack, never ice directly on skin, never hold your breath or submerge your head. If unsure, check with your GP. Stop if you feel dizzy or unwell.
safety.crisis: If you're in crisis or need someone now: Samaritans 116 123 (free, 24/7) · Pieta 1800 247 247 · Emergency 999 or 112

breathe.comfort: Shorter exhale, just go at your pace
breathe.settled: Po is settled. Stay as long as you like.

s1.title: Your Now cards
s1.intro: If you like, pick up to three for the Now screen. You choose once, while you feel steady, so Now never needs a decision.
s1.limit: Three chosen. Untick one to swap.

s2.title: Quiet and handoff
s2.quietHint: The screen dims, Po sleeps and nothing is asked.
s2.handoffHint: It opens in your messaging app, where you choose who receives it. No contact is stored here.

s3.title: How Po looks
s3.intro: One option: check that Po is easy to see, then pick the look that suits you.

s4.title: Movement and sound
s4.intro: Both can be changed any time in Settings.

evidence-bank.intro: Things that went well, or that others have said about you. Add one whenever you like.

parking-lot.intro: Write a thought that isn't settled and put it here. It will wait.

appointment-prep.intro: Points to raise at your next session. They stay here until you remove them.

repair-note.intro: An optional note for another day.

pros.intro: Lay out both sides. Nothing here is saved.
